Bakerloo.reason: Bakerloo Line: Severe delays between Queen's Park and Harrow & Wealdstone due to an earlier fire alert at Queen's Park. MINOR DELAYS on the rest of the line due to train cancellations. Tickets will be accepted on London Buses and Lioness line via any reasonable route.

Jubilee.reason: Jubilee Line: Minor delays due to an earlier fire alert at Wembley Park.

Metropolitan.reason: Metropolitan Line: Minor delays between Harrow-on-the-Hill and Aldgate due to a track fault at Wembley Park. GOOD SERVICE on the rest of the line.
